component.name: LoginScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.hints = ["Endereço do servidor", "Usuário", "Senha"] m.vals = [RegGet("server"), RegGet("user"), RegGet("pass")] m.rects = [m.top.findNode("r0"), m.top.findNode("r1"), m.top.findNode("r2"), m.top.findNode("r3")] m.vlabels = [m.top.findNode("v0"), m.top.findNode("v1"), m.top.findNode("v2")] m.msg = m.top.findNode("msg") m.kb = m.top.findNode("kb") m.dim = m.top.findNode("dim") m.kb.observeField("submit", "onKbSubmit") m.idx = 0 m.editing = false refreshFields() if m.vals[0] <> "" and m.vals[1] <> "" and m.vals[2] <> "" doLogin() end if end sub
sub refocus() if m.editing m.kb.setFocus(true) else m.top.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub refreshFields() for i = 0 to 2 if m.vals[i] = "" m.vlabels[i].text = m.hints[i] m.vlabels[i].color = "0xFFFFFF77" else v = m.vals[i] if i = 2 then v = String(Len(v), "*") m.vlabels[i].text = v m.vlabels[i].color = "0xFFFFFFFF" end if end for for i = 0 to 3 if i = m.idx m.rects[i].color = "0xE5231FFF" else m.rects[i].color = "0x2B2B2BEE" end if end for end sub
sub openKb() m.kb.text = m.vals[m.idx] m.kb.hint = m.hints[m.idx] m.kb.secret = (m.idx = 2) m.kb.okLabel = "OK" m.dim.visible = true m.kb.visible = true m.editing = true m.kb.setFocus(true) end sub
sub closeKb() m.kb.visible = false m.dim.visible = false m.editing = false m.top.setFocus(true) refreshFields() end sub
sub onKbSubmit() m.vals[m.idx] = m.kb.text closeKb() if m.idx < 3 then m.idx = m.idx + 1 refreshFields() end sub
sub doLogin() srv = m.vals[0].Trim() usr = m.vals[1].Trim() pwd = m.vals[2].Trim() if srv = "" or usr = "" or pwd = "" m.msg.text = "Preencha o servidor, o usuário e a senha." return end if if Left(LCase(srv), 4) <> "http" then srv = "http://" + srv while Right(srv, 1) = "/" srv = Left(srv, Len(srv) - 1) end while m.pending = { server: srv, user: usr, pass: pwd } m.global.session = m.pending m.msg.text = "Entrando..." Fetch(Api(""), "auth", "onAuth") end sub
sub onAuth(event as Object) res = event.getData() ok = false if res.ok d = res.data if type(d) = "roAssociativeArray" ui = d.user_info if type(ui) = "roAssociativeArray" if Sx(ui.auth) = "1" then ok = true end if end if end if if ok RegSet("server", m.pending.server) RegSet("user", m.pending.user) RegSet("pass", m.pending.pass) m.top.loggedIn = true else m.global.session = {} m.msg.text = "Não foi possível entrar. Confira os dados e a internet." end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if m.editing if key = "back" closeKb() return true end if return false end if if key = "down" if m.idx < 3 then m.idx = m.idx + 1 refreshFields() return true else if key = "up" if m.idx > 0 then m.idx = m.idx - 1 refreshFields() return true else if key = "OK" if m.idx < 3 openKb() else doLogin() end if return true end if return false end function
